proposition: According to Melvin-Koushki, older Western reference works knew Ibn Turka thinly: Brockelmann only the Fusus commentary, Storey as a Sufi author and stylist listing only the Munazarat-i Khams, Browne only in passing as converting Katibi to Sufism, and the EI2 has no entry for him though it has one for the three family members named Afdal al-Din Turka.

mediation.note: The position is this scholar's own; we have it only as summarised by Melvin-Koushki.
MK argues a rival reading (Ibn Turka as occult philosopher) and in places calls this reading an error; his summary may compress or foreshorten it.
